name: Export glb
explanation: Exports a model to the glb (binary) format.

exposed_options.name: Geometry Compression
exposed_options.description: Desired geometry compression method for glTF/glb exports.

exposed_options.name: Texture Map Format
exposed_options.description: Format for exported texture maps. Default is auto = jpg + png for alpha textures.

exposed_options.name: Normal Map Format
exposed_options.description: Format for exported normal maps. Default is auto = jpg + png for alpha textures.

exposed_options.name: Texture Resolution
exposed_options.description: Resolution for exported texture maps. Default is 4096x4096.

exposed_options.name: Separate Occlusion
exposed_options.description: Export occlusion as a separate map instead of including it in the ORM map.

exposed_options.name: Exclude Material Extensions
exposed_options.description: If true, no glTF material PBR extensions are exported. Transmission/Volume will fall back to alpha blend.

exposed_options.name: Force Double Sided Materials
exposed_options.description: Exports all materials as double sided.

exposed_options.name: Force Unlit Materials
exposed_options.description: Enables that all materials are specified as unlit, for .gltf/.glb export.

exposed_options.name: Convert to MetalRoughness
exposed_options.description: Converts materials from spec/gloss to metal/rough.
